cards.title: Three people. One prescription. No gaps.
cards.body: A prescription passes through a doctor, a chemist and a patient. Today each holds a different piece. AICA's trident puts them on one shared thread.

cards.title: Patients: clarity at home
cards.body: Scan and confirm prescriptions, get reminders for 1-0-1 and half tablets, manage parents through family profiles, and keep vitals and a care diary.

cards.title: Chemists: a smarter counter
cards.body: AI help reading handwriting, and refill predictions that bring patients back to the pharmacy they already trust.

cards.title: Doctors: context before the visit
cards.body: Clinics get a patient summary before the consult, so time goes into care rather than piecing together history.

cards.title: Why all three, together
cards.body: Fix only one side and the gaps just move somewhere else. When everyone works from the same thread, fewer things fall through.

cards.title: Starting in Lucknow
cards.body: Pilots are starting in Lucknow. Founding pharmacies and clinics use AICA free during the pilot. Join the waitlist at aicaglobal.in.

takeaway: AICA's trident links patients, chemists and doctors on one prescription thread so each side sees what it needs.
share: Patients, chemists and doctors on one prescription thread. That's the AICA trident.
